symptom: Occasionally associated with early cardiovascular symptoms
Stiffness, worse in the morning or after rest
Mild bleeding gums or easy bruising
Symptoms triggered by exercise, cold air, or allergens
Pain related to meals (before or after eating)
Worse when lying down or after large meals
Sudden severe joint pain (classically big toe)
Extreme tenderness (even light touch is painful)
Symmetric joint pain and swelling (hands, wrists, feet)
Unilateral throbbing pain, nausea, light/sound sensitivity (migraine)
Sudden spinning sensation triggered by head/position change
Dull or aching lower back pain
Pica (craving non-food items like ice or dirt)
Distribution often in flexural areas (atopic) or contact sites
Small papules/burrows, often between fingers, wrists, groin
Similar symptoms in close contacts/family members
Itchy, ring-shaped rash with central clearing
In infants: irritability, ear-pulling, poor feeding
Red/swollen tonsils, possibly with white patches
Fatigue that can persist for weeks
Itchy anus (especially pinworm, worse at night)
